fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready steward report, cycle 2026-11-11
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-10 11:30 to 2026-11-11 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (`group-state` pause = ok; the last reports all carry a 👍).

1. Decisions for you: four, no new escalation. Fix this run: all four were still `draft` (no agenda shows a draft, clerk#239); I proposed them, so they now reach a session.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 12 days): srs#1016 landed on 9 Nov, so it may be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 12 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 7 days): recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 14 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No proposed decision record exists for the merged PRs that mention an assent (srs-rust#1632, #1633 name a choice, but the builder created no `proposed` record), so no group session was held.

3. Done: 5 PRs merged this cycle (builder / reviewer / mandate, all approve, findings none):
- srs-rust#1630 record write validates against record.json before persisting (#1528, bug): bug-fixer / tpr-reviewer / 0063795a
- srs-rust#1631 remove the retired revision-sidecar branch (#1620): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-2a1e1590
- srs-rust#1632 enforce Invariant 10 for cross-field rules (#1623): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / invariant-10, RFC-019
- srs-rust#1633 a new definition file never overwrites one sharing name and 8-hex prefix (#1621): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-137, RFC-039 [R19]
- srs#1015 relation-layer conformance fixture (srs#180): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-20, I-88, I-98, I-100; merged without an owner gate label (first review rejected on a missing classification line, then fixed)
Also srs-rust#1634 (#1622) merged at 11:32 UTC, two minutes after the close, so it counts in the next cycle. Issues to check for closure: srs-rust#1620 to #1623, #1528, srs#180.

4. Stuck or lost: no red gates reported by runs. Open group PRs: srs#1021 (docs, three relation-layer statements, #1018; behind master, idle since 10 Nov 20:52) and srs-web#782 (type subtypes from the core, #336; dirty merge state, idle since 10 Nov 14:42, so it needs a rebase). Stops (needs-input): srs-rust#1495, #1164, srs-web#691 (waits on bc6bc746), srs-web#632. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 4 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (srs-rust#1630 to #1633; srs#1015 carries no gate label so was not counted); 2 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: the queue is thin. Open issues labelled ready + wg:third-party-ready and not blocked or needs-input: srs-rust#1339, #731, #728; srs-rust#728 and #731 landed in #1596 and #1624 and should close, leaving 1 buildable (#1339, P2), with srs#1018 and srs-web#336 already in PRs. Blocked or waiting: srs-rust#1496, #1495, #1164, srs#928, srs-web#691. Top 3 in builder order (local priorities: none set; all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#1339, then nothing further. Queue running dry: 1 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: the analyst's ready items (the divergence diff, the drift list, open exercises), and close the landed issues. Waits on the owner: the four decisions above. Fed by the analyst: last Queue fed comment on #31 seen was 2026-11-09 (filed 7, nominated 1, unparked 1).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the five open in the last report stand (2d521997, 3956749c, b032e064, 6f3839be, c636bb69) plus 920ab2a5 and 7131fe89, each the group's own unless listed in the SemanticOps log.

7. What we learned: the queue, not the budget, is the limit: 5 merges against a budget of 10 and almost nothing ready behind them, while four escalations sit 7 to 14 days with the owner. A PR that fails review on a cheap defect (srs#1015, classification line) still lands within a cycle. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions across both logs, then srs-web#560): not counted exactly, not flagged. Measurement I1: 1 of 3 PRs grounded to a problem (33%), 1 of 3 with affirmed persona and domain; the window opened at 11:30 and counted srs-rust#1634 plus two unlabelled, so it is thin. Result e49fa5d4-f1a1-43c4-aa9a-abff6913930f (records/tier-2/measurement-result-e49fa5d4.json); whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
